quests.instruction: Which letters blend together at the start of "SNAKE"?
quests.hint: In a blend, you can still hear BOTH letters if you say it slowly.
quests.explanation: SN is a blend in "SNAKE" -- you can hear both letters if you say it slowly!
quests.funFact: The blend 'sn' makes a slippery, sniffing sound.
